decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess evidence gaps and determine fit.

role.roleTitle: Product Requirements Analyst, Equipment Maintenance Services

evidence.text: Gathered requirements from field technicians and the depot team through ride‑alongs and depot visits, and wrote the user stories and acceptance criteria for the offline checklist and parts‑scan features of the technician app.
Organised acceptance rounds for four app releases at the training site with a rotating group of technicians, and kept the results per criterion in a shared sheet.

a slide from the candidate's portfolio deck says 'average visit time down 22 minutes after parts‑scan'; the slide has no source, period or region, and the candidate said in the screen that the number came from a regional manager's email he no longer has.

missingEvidence: No documented measurement of average on‑site visit time before and after the delivered feature, no baseline data, no verification of the 22‑minute reduction

evidence.text: Coordinated release scope with the engineering lead and the field‑service manager in the release planning meeting; the engineering lead decided scope and dates, and the field‑service manager approved the rollout order across regions.
Wrote up each app release for the regional trainers, flagging that parts‑scan only worked on the newer handheld model and listing the steps trainers had to take over.
